_meta.description: REAL ground truth for the 2021 Chao Phraya flood (Tropical Storm DIANMU / เตี้ยนหมู่, 24-27 Sep 2021) — GISTDA satellite flood-area analysis published via thaiwater.net (same product family as ground_truth_2022). Used for the Item-4 generalization test (2nd event, different year).

diff_vs_2022.note: Generalization difference: Tak flooded in 2022 (58,598 rai, in gold) but NOT in 2021 (2,208 rai, below cutoff). 2021 gold = 6 provinces, 2022 gold = 7. Same graph, different real gold -> tests whether the causal model generalizes.
